correctness.rationale: Using published local square criterion, odd prime bad event v_p(k)=2j≥2 with negative unit quadratic residue has Haar mass Σ_{j≥1}(p-1)/(2p^{2j+1})=1/[2p(p+1)]; at 2, even valuation≥4 with unit 3 mod4 has mass Σ_{j≥2}2^{-(2j+2)}=1/48. CRT yields independent Bernoulli models for finitely many prime tests; discarded large-prime events cost O(1/Y), large valuations O(2^{-2L}), and nonuniform finite residues modulo M cost O(M/X). Choosing L=ceil(loglog X), Y=floor(log X/(100loglogX)), Chebyshev bound ensures M≤X^{1/2} for sufficiently large X, yielding O(loglog X/logX) total variation. Independent first-1000 exact bad count 98; n≤100000 obstruction histogram (B=0,1,2,3)=(90140,9516,343,1); partial Euler product to 10^6 gives δ≈0.901295043, explicit tail <5e-7.
